title: Wouldn't Buy Again
text: Wouldn't Buy Again. The rods are a bit flimsy but for price fair. People is there's no center support that comes in kit and when expanded of course sags so had to invest near same amount as rod set cost to buy center rod support. Made for sheer curtains only, doesn't support heavy drapes even with support.

product_metadata.title: Urbanest Square Urn Adjustable Double Drapery Curtain Rod Set, 5/8", 48"-84", Black
features: The rod set includes 2 rods, 2 sets of two finials, and double brackets in a black finish

The front adjustable curtain rod measures 5/8" diameter and comes with square urn finials; the back adjustable curtain rod measures 1/2" diameter and comes with flat button shaped finials. Both rods extend from 48" to 84".
Three matching double brackets included. All brackets measure 5" long, 2 1/2" to center of first bracket cup, and 5" to center of second bracket cup. 1 1/2" wall mount span.
Available in 5 finishes: Black, Glossy White, Bronze, Pewter, and Antique Gold
Mounting hardware included for easy installation.
